brief: Ten controlled variations of #22 Overlap, preserving the layered C with simple flat geometry.

concepts.name: Flat original
concepts.idea: Keep the recognizable silhouette; replace gradients with flat color.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Edit target: the attached #22 Overlap Codealong logo. Create ONE controlled logo variation from this exact mark, not a new unrelated symbol. Preserve its essential identity: a right-opening capital C assembled from two broad curved pieces, with a single darker intersection on the left. Friendly, confident, compact and readable as a C at 24 pixels. Two principal ink colors plus ONE solid darker intersection color are allowed.
Style constraints: strictly flat, clean geometric vector-like artwork. Uniform solid color inside every region, perfectly crisp edges. NO gradients, shading, shadows, 3D, perspective, bevels, glass, highlights, textures, thin details, outlines, extra symbols, dots, arrows, letters other than the C, words, labels or watermark. The original image has gradients: deliberately eliminate them. The overlap is shown by a simple flat third-color shape, not lighting or a folded ribbon.
Composition: exactly one large centered standalone mark on a pure white square canvas, approximately 68% of canvas size, generous even margins. Do not add a tile or presentation mockup.

Specific variation 91: Preserve the original silhouette very closely, including its broad rounded ends and slightly organic C proportions. Clean the contour into smooth deliberate arcs. Upper piece solid turquoise #43CEC9, lower piece cobalt #315CF6, overlap dark teal-blue #145B91. Only change the rendering to entirely solid colors and slightly regularize the curves.
